info.name: Get feature flags for the currently logged in user.

params.name: project_id
params.description:
project_id optionally scopes flag evaluation to the given project. The
caller must be a member of the project. When set, flags are evaluated with
the project in the targeting context in addition to the user and org.

items.docs:
A successful response from this resource will contain a map of
all feature flags and the value assigned to each of them for the user.
